description: Class representing a container for paragraphs and tables.

AddElement.description: Adds a paragraph or a table or a blockLvl content control using its position in the document content.

params.description: The position where the current element will be added.
params.name: nPos

params.description: The document element which will be added at the current position.
params.name: oElement

AddParagraph.description: Creates a new paragraph and appends it to the end of the document content.

AddText.description: Appends the specified text to the end of the document content.

GetAllCharts.description: Returns a collection of chart objects from the document content.

GetAllDrawingObjects.description: Returns a collection of drawing objects from the document content.

GetAllImages.description: Returns a collection of image objects from the document content.

GetAllOleObjects.description: Returns a collection of OLE objects from the document content.

GetAllParagraphs.description: Returns an array of all paragraphs from the current document content.

GetAllShapes.description: Returns a collection of shape objects from the document content.

GetAllTables.description: Returns an array of all tables from the current document content.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiDocumentContent class.

GetContent.description: Returns an array of document elements from the current ApiDocumentContent object.

params.description: Specifies if the copies of the document elements will be returned or not.
params.name: bGetCopies

GetCurrentContentControl.description: Returns the currently selected content control.

GetCurrentParagraph.description: Returns the current paragraph where the cursor is located.

GetCurrentRun.description: Returns the current run where the cursor is located.

GetDocumentVisitor.description: Returns a visitor object for traversing the elements of the current document.
GetDocumentVisitor.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: A document visitor that can be used to inspect or process the document structure.

GetElement.description: Returns an element by its position in the document.

params.description: The element position that will be taken from the document.
params.name: nPos

GetElementIndex.description: Returns the position (index) of the specified element within the current document content.

params.description: The document element (paragraph, table or block content control) whose index will be returned.
params.name: element

returns.description: returns -1 if the element is not a direct child of the current document content.

GetElementsCount.description: Returns a number of elements in the current document.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal ID of the current document content.

GetRange.description: Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the document content.

params.description: Start position index in the current element.
params.name: Start

params.description: End position index in the current element.
params.name: End

GetText.description: Returns the inner text of the current document content object.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options
params.type: { Numbering?: boolean; Math?: boolean; TableCellSeparator?: string; TableRowSeparator?: string; ParaSeparator?: string; TabSymbol?: string; NewLineSeparator?: string }

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: { Numbering?: boolean; Math?: boolean; TableCellSeparator?: string; TableRowSeparator?: string; ParaSeparator?: string; TabSymbol?: string; NewLineSeparator?: string }): string

IsEndnote.description: Check if the current document content is an endnote.

IsFootnote.description: Check if the current document content is a footnote.

MoveCursorToNoteReference.description:
Moves the cursor to the reference of this footnote/endnote in the main document.

If this document content is not a footnote/endnote, does nothing.

params.description: Specifies whether to place the cursor before (_true_) or after (_false_) the note reference.
params.name: isBefore

returns.description: Returns _true_ if the cursor was moved to the reference successfully.

Push.description: Pushes a paragraph or a table to actually add it to the document.

params.description: The element type which will be pushed to the document.
params.name: oElement

returns.description: returns false if oElement is unsupported.

RemoveAllElements.description:
Removes all the elements from the current document or from the current document element.

**Note:**
When all elements are removed, a new empty paragraph is automatically created. If you want to add
content to this paragraph, use the {@link ApiDocumentContent#GetElement} method.

RemoveElement.description: Removes an element using the position specified.

params.description: The element number (position) in the document or inside other element.
params.name: nPos

SelectNoteReference.description:
Selects the reference to this footnote/endnote.

If this document content is not a footnote/endnote, do nothing.

returns.description: Returns true if the reference was selected successfully.

SetText.description:
Replaces all content of the current document content object with the specified text,
preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiDocumentContent object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: isWriteNumberings

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: isWriteStyles
